children: Shoals Technologies Group entered into Amendment No. 8 to its Credit Agreement to simplify collateral perfection on certain cash and securities accounts. Under the change, maintaining deposit, securities, and commodity accounts at JPMorgan Chase Bank is sufficient to establish control, eliminating the need for separate control agreements. The update is expected to streamline documentation, reduce administrative overhead, and improve operational flexibility.
: JPMorgan Chase Bank, as Administrative Agent; Wilmington Trust, as Collateral Agent; and the lenders
: Streamline collateral perfection and reduce administrative burden
